request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: Given that the company works in mining areas (extractive sector), how often will the IGEA-PRIM 5t overhead travelling crane at position 13 have to be verified in 2028?

response.text: {"kind": "duration", "value": "P1Y", "text": "In 2028 the IGEA-PRIM 5t bridge crane (position 13, manufactured 2017) is 11 years old, so it falls under the 'fixed, extractive sector, manufactured more than 10 years earlier' row of Allegato VII of D.Lgs. 81/2008, which requires annual verification. This assumes a bridge crane counts as 'fisso', which the files do not state explicitly.", "sources": [{"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 15", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo e con anno di fabbricazione antecedente 10 anni | Verifiche annuali"}, {"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 16", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg , non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo e con anno di fabbricazione non antecedente 10 anni | Verifiche biennali"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 6, Tabella A2", "quote": "GRU A PONTE 2017- 13 IGEA -PRIM 5t 5000 2017 gen-17 SCORREVOLE 200086/CA 6"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 3, section 2.2", "quote": "Qtà COMUNE Area mineraria Monteponi 19 Iglesias Campo Pisano"}]}
